description: This file defines the class Vtiger_LinkData, which encapsulates data related to a link, user, module, and input parameters within the vtiger CRM system. It provides methods to access these data points, typically used for managing link-related data in the application.

classes.name: Vtiger_LinkData
classes.description: A class representing link-related data within the vtiger CRM system, providing accessors for link, user, module, and input parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the link, user, module, and input properties based on parameters and the current request context.

methods.name: getInputParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific input parameter by name from the stored input data.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link object associated with this data.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user object associated with this link data.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the current module name associated with this link data.
